_note: Scripted incident call for the demo, against data/world.json (checkout failing after orders-api v2.14; orders-db CPU 98%). `pause` is the silence after the line, in seconds. `expect` is what Egg Head should do on that line, for the run report.
title: Checkout failures after the orders-api deploy

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Okay everyone, checkout is failing for about a third of users. What are we seeing?

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Orders API is throwing a lot of 500s.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: The orders DB is fine, CPU is normal.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Okay, so let's focus on the API then.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Oh, good catch. I was looking at the payments database.

lines.speaker: Mei
lines.text: Hold on, are you sure? I think v2.14 went out this morning.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: The auth service is completely down.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Auth isn't in the checkout path, let's park that.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Jordan, roll back orders-api to v2.13.
